hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); base=${file##*/}; case "$base" in *.example|*.sample|*.template|*.dist|example.env|sample.env) exit 0;; esac; case "$base" in .env|.env.*) echo "Blocked: $base may contain secrets" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$file" in *.sh) command -v shfmt >/dev/null && shfmt -w "$file"; command -v shellcheck >/dev/null && shellcheck "$file" ;; esac || true
